headline: Chip sell-off leads US stocks lower
summary: The S&P 500 fell 1.92% and the Nasdaq Composite lost 2.49%. The semiconductor index fell more sharply, though the report also noted weakness beyond technology.

highlights.title: Semiconductors led the decline
highlights.text: The original report flags chip export policy and uncertainty ahead of Nvidia earnings. The sell-off alone does not establish a deterioration in chip orders.

forecast.outlook: Equal weight on the upside and downside tails
forecast.horizon: 17–19 November US sessions · S&P 500 final close
forecast.method: Original section 3.1 forecast. The report averages realised-volatility, comparable VIX and normal-model estimates, without a discretionary tilt. Boundaries are inclusive in the base case.
forecast.watch_next: Watch Nvidia guidance, Federal Reserve minutes and whether market breadth improves.

limitations: The report flags sensitivity to the VIX source, overlapping windows and event risk not modelled separately. The 11 scored US windows were not all re-read and do not establish calibration.
